external_sources.title: Uniform approximation and explicit estimates for the prolate spheroidal wave functions

locked_conventions.source_inverse_function: Phi is the increasing inverse of k mapsto k/E(k)

locked_result.derivation: Apply k mapsto k/E(k) to the source inequality, then invert the positive bounds after writing sqrt(chi_n(c))*E(c/sqrt(chi_n(c)))=c/(k/E(k)) with k=c/sqrt(chi_n(c)).
locked_result.plus_phase_consequence: For consecutive labels n and n+4, A(chi_(n+4)(c))-A(chi_n(c))>3*pi/2.

proved_by_source: the strict two-sided action bracket for every c>0 and n>=2
the derived strict 3*pi/2 action separation for labels n and n+4
not_claimed: no PSWF counting asymptotic beyond the locked action bracket
